mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE > 5.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates supply-demand mismatch that disrupts economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with INDPRO decline and RSAFS rise, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), higher borrowing costs dampen corporate investment and consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising employment trend (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with HOUST > 900.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals persistent inflation without monetary accommodation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL rise and FEDFUNDS stability, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During strong manufacturing expansion (INDPRO > 105.0), robust industrial output supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with INDPRO > 105.0, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.
